name: Shoe trees + polish kit

lead: Shoe trees are inserts, usually of cedar, that hold a shoe's shape when it is off the foot. A polish kit includes brush, cream and wax to clean and shine leather.

They are used to keep shoes looking neat and extend their life. Style commentators note that shoes are a visible part of an outfit. No specific scholarly sources were found for shoe care, though research on shoes and impression formation exists.

paras: Trees stretch out creases and absorb moisture while the shoe dries, and polish conditions and fills scuffs.
Poor technique or the wrong polish may stain or dry leather. Some shoes need specific care. The visual effect is temporary.
